test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 20 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 5 persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). B is sitting second to the right of D. A is sitting second to the right of B. C is not an immediate neighbour of A. Who is sitting third to the right of C?
solution:
Given: 5 persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

B is sitting second to the right of D.

A is sitting second to the right of B.

C is not an immediate neighbour of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/622f26e14c334b8dc10286dec80e61af314c51e1f04c7944a172233760ec09a6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c09fe920befb7ed54917f4d7b49ecd9f97ca1ee65f0e04d5d08e6563f003f5fb.png] 

Here, A is sitting third to the right of C.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
